non_blocking.section: Decision outcome (Service row) and More information
non_blocking.suggestion: Foundation pack section 8.4 lists 8091 authentication as "mTLS, per-Node enrollment certificate", and section 2 describes the Control Stream as gRPC "over mTLS". The Service row, "unary `Enroll` (one-time token, server CA pinned)", states the server-authenticated-TLS exception as already settled. That exception is still a proposed pack amendment (OQ-security-and-identity-31), and the ADR mentions it only in More information. Add "(pending pack 8.4 amendment, OQ-security-and-identity-31)" inline in the Service row so the table does not read as a silent deviation from the pack.

Pack 8.2 says every snapshot, delta and heartbeat carries the promoted digest, and the owning document's `Snapshot` and `Delta` rows include `promotion`. The Delivery row and the Figure 1 labels ("Delta with nonce, baseDigest, ops and signature", "Snapshot chunks with nonce, offset, totalBytes and signature") leave it out. Add `promotion` to both, so readers do not conclude that only `HeartbeatReply` carries it.

Pack 8.3 says a deterministic NACK "fails the gate at once". The ADR, following the owning document, says it fails the gate "once Ruralz Control reproduces it, else it counts as transient". The two are compatible, because pack 8.3 defines a deterministic NACK as one that reproduces from the Revision, but add a short clause saying that reproduction is how Ruralz Control applies that definition. Otherwise a pedantic reader may see a softening of the pack.

The stale-replica branch shows only "Last committed assignment only to a Node with no active digest". The owning document (Fencing stale replicas) also says a stale replica answers other Nodes with nothing, sends `HeartbeatReply` with its last promotion, and after 30 s stale (target) sends `Reconnect` (`rebalance`). Extend the node label or add one node so the figure matches the owning document.
